'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Charlie Arlandson LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Charlie Arlandson]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Brazen
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
